title: Maximize Subarray GCD Score
summary: Given an array of positive integers nums and an integer k, you can double at most k elements in the array.
statement: Given an array of positive integers nums and an integer k, you can double at most k elements in the array. The score of a contiguous subarray is defined as the product of its length and the greatest common divisor (GCD) of all its elements. Your task is to find the maximum score that can be achieved by selecting a contiguous subarray from the modified array. The greatest common divisor (GCD) of an array is the largest integer that divides all the array elements without a remainder.
constraints: nums has up to 1,500 positive integers; each element may be doubled at most once.
Use at most k doublings, where 1 <= k <= len(nums).
A subarray score is its length times its GCD after selected doublings.
reference_solution:
def maximum_subarray_gcd_score(nums,k):
    from math import gcd
    powers=[]
    for value in nums:
        count=0
        while value%2==0:count+=1;value//=2
        powers.append(count)
    answer=0
    for left in range(len(nums)):
        common=0;minimum=10**30;minimum_count=0
        for right in range(left,len(nums)):
            common=gcd(common,nums[right])
            if powers[right]<minimum:minimum=powers[right];minimum_count=1
            elif powers[right]==minimum:minimum_count+=1
            score=common*(2 if minimum_count<=k else 1)*(right-left+1)
            answer=max(answer,score)
    return answer

hints: Doubling a subarray’s GCD is possible exactly when every element with the minimum power-of-two exponent is doubled.
Enumerate each subarray while maintaining its GCD, minimum two-adic exponent, and the count attaining that minimum.
Extend rightward; update GCD and minimum-count; multiply GCD by two only when that count is at most k.
Odd prime factors cannot be improved by doubling, and the shared power of two rises exactly when all minimum-exponent elements receive the operation.

tests.explanation: Doubling two to four makes the length-two subarray GCD four, for score eight.
Doubling the singleton seven produces score fourteen, which is optimal.
